name: Doctor & Dentist Visits
description: Children's routine and non-urgent health care: checkups, vaccines, dental cleanings, eye tests, and specialist referrals.

name: Medications & First Aid
description: The household's medicines and minor medical care: prescriptions, vitamins, everyday remedies, and treating small injuries and illnesses.

name: Sick Days
description: Looking after a child who is too unwell for school or daycare, and handling the disruption that follows.

name: Medical Paperwork
description: The administration of the family's health care: bills, insurance claims, referrals, approvals, and health records.

name: Morning Routine
description: Getting children from waking up to out of the door, calm and on time, on school and daycare mornings.

name: Bedtime Routine
description: Getting children from the end of the evening to asleep, at a consistent time, on every ordinary night.

name: Bath & Grooming
description: Children's personal care: baths or showers, hair, nails, teeth, skin, and haircuts. Later, teaching them to do these for themselves.

name: Night Wakings
description: Whatever a child needs between bedtime and morning: feeds, bad dreams, illness, a wet bed, or simply not being able to sleep.

name: Supervising Kids
description: Being the adult who is on duty and paying attention when the children are at home and awake, outside the set routines.

name: Homework & Learning
description: Supporting children's schoolwork at home: homework, reading, projects, test preparation, supplies, and extra help when it is needed.

name: Screens & Online Safety
description: Children's use of phones, tablets, games, TV, and the internet: how much, what, when, and how they stay safe.

name: Family Rules & Discipline
description: The expectations children live by and what happens when those are not met, applied the same way by both of you.

name: Emotional Check-ins
description: Knowing how each child is really doing on the inside, and being the person they can bring their worries to.

name: Friendships & Playdates
description: Children's social lives: getting to know their friends, arranging time together, and helping them handle the ups and downs.

name: Diapers & Potty
description: Everything involved in a young child's toileting, from the first diaper through to being reliably dry day and night.

name: Feeding Little Ones
description: Feeding babies and toddlers: breast or bottle, pumping, introducing solid food, and meals and snacks through the day.

name: Therapies & Extra Support
description: Getting a child the additional help they need, whether developmental, learning, physical, or emotional, and coordinating everyone involved.

name: Life Skills
description: Teaching children what they need to become capable, considerate people: chores, manners, money, safety, and looking after themselves.

name: Backup Care
description: Handling the days when normal care falls through: a closed school, a sick sitter, bad weather, or a last-minute change.

name: Aging Parents & Relatives
description: Supporting older or unwell family members: their health, safety, money, housing, and company.

name: Family Planning
description: Decisions about whether and when to have children, and the contraception, fertility care, or appointments that follow from them.

name: Self-Care
description: Your own physical and mental health: sleep, exercise, medical and dental care, and time to rest. Each of you holds this card for yourself.

name: Your Own Clothes & Grooming
description: Looking after your own appearance and wardrobe: haircuts, personal care, and clothes for work, home, and occasions. Each of you holds this for yourself.

name: Your Own Friendships
description: Keeping up the friendships that are yours and not the couple's. Each of you holds this card for yourself.

name: Partner Check-in
description: A regular conversation between the two of you about how the household is running and how each of you is doing. You hold this one together.

name: Laundry
description: Everyone's clothes, from the hamper to back in the drawer. Covers everyday washing, stains, and special-care items. Bedding and towels are on the Beds & Linens card.

name: Dishes
description: Getting every dish, pot, bottle, and lunch container clean and back in the cabinet, so the kitchen is ready for the next meal.

name: Trash & Recycling
description: Getting trash, recycling, and compost out of the house and collected, including the wastebaskets in every room and the cans outside.

name: Groceries
description: Keeping the household stocked with food and drink for the week's meals, snacks, and staples. Non-food supplies are on the Household Supplies card.

name: Weeknight Dinners
description: The evening meal, Monday to Friday: deciding what it is, making it, and getting it on the table. Cleanup is on the Dishes card.

name: Breakfasts
description: The weekday morning meal for everyone in the house, fitted into the time there really is before people leave.

name: Packed Lunches
description: Lunches and snacks that leave the house for school, daycare, or work, including water bottles and the containers they travel in.

name: Weekend Meals
description: Every meal from Friday night to Sunday night that is not a planned outing: breakfasts, lunches, dinners, and food for guests.

name: Kitchen Reset
description: Returning the kitchen and eating area to a clean, clear state each day, beyond the dishes themselves.

name: Fridge & Pantry
description: Keeping the fridge, freezer, and cabinets clean, organized, and free of expired food, so people can see what there is and less gets wasted.

name: Daily Tidying
description: Keeping shared spaces picked up day to day: the things that land on floors, counters, stairs, and tables. Cleaning itself is on the Deep Cleaning card.

name: Deep Cleaning
description: The regular proper clean of the home: bathrooms, floors, dusting, and the occasional bigger jobs such as windows, ovens, and behind furniture.

name: Household Supplies
description: Everything the home runs on that is not food: toilet paper, soap, cleaning products, light bulbs, batteries, toiletries, and the like.

name: Maintenance & Repairs
description: Keeping the home itself in working order: fixing what breaks and doing the routine upkeep that prevents bigger problems.

name: Yard & Plants
description: Everything growing in and around the home: lawn, garden beds, trees, and houseplants. Also outdoor clearing such as leaves, snow, and ice.

name: Mail & Paperwork
description: All the paper and mail that enters the home: letters, bills, school papers, forms, and the documents that need keeping.

name: Beds & Linens
description: Clean sheets, towels, and bedding throughout the home, and replacing them when they wear out.

name: Seasonal Swap & Storage
description: Moving clothes, gear, and decorations in and out with the seasons, and keeping closets, the garage, the attic, and other storage in order.

name: Furnishings & Decor
description: The furniture and things that make the home work and feel like yours: seating, storage, lighting, rugs, curtains, and what goes on the walls.

name: Tech & Devices
description: The household's technology: Wi-Fi, computers, phones, tablets, TV and streaming, printers, smart devices, and the accounts that go with them.

name: Home Safety
description: Making the home safe and being ready for emergencies: alarms, first-aid supplies, locks, hazards, and a family plan.

name: Dog Daily Care
description: The dogs' everyday needs: meals, fresh water, daily medications, walks, and picking up after them. Vet visits and grooming are on a separate card.

name: Hosting Guests
description: Having people in your home, whether for dinner or a week's stay: getting ready, looking after them, and putting the house back afterward.

name: Kids' Clothes & Gear
description: Making sure each child has clothes and shoes that fit and suit the season, plus the gear that school and activities require.

name: Baby Laundry
description: The baby's own wash: clothes, sleepers, bibs, burp cloths, swaddles, crib sheets, and washable blankets, through to being back in the nursery.

name: Dehumidifier Tanks
description: Keeping the home's two dehumidifiers running: emptying both tanks before they fill and shut off, and keeping the units clean.

name: Air & Furnace Filters
description: Replacing the home's five air filters and the furnace filter every six months, so the heating and cooling system runs cleanly and efficiently.

name: Kids' Birthdays
description: Celebrating each of your children's birthdays: the day itself, a party if there is one, and their present.

name: Family Birthdays
description: Remembering and marking the birthdays of your partner, relatives, and close friends.

name: Gifts for Family
description: Presents for the people in your immediate and extended family, for birthdays, holidays, and other occasions.

name: Gifts for Others
description: Presents and cards for people outside the family: children's party hosts, teachers, coaches, neighbors, colleagues, and friends.

name: Holiday Planning
description: The holidays and festivals your family celebrates through the year: where you will be, who with, and everything that makes the day.

name: Holiday Cards
description: The cards or greetings you send to family and friends each year, if you choose to send them.

name: Family Traditions
description: The rituals that make your family feel like itself, large and small: Friday pizza, the first-day-of-school photo, the annual trip.

name: Make-Believe Visitors
description: The tooth fairy, holiday gift-bringers, and any other magical figures your family keeps alive for young children.

name: Photos & Memories
description: Keeping the family's record: photos, videos, artwork, school keepsakes, and the things you will want to look back on.

name: Thank-You Notes
description: Thanking people properly for presents, hospitality, and kindness, on behalf of yourselves and your children.

name: Small Gestures for Your Partner
description: The everyday acts that show your partner you see them and care. Each of you holds this card for the other.

name: Small Gestures for Kids
description: The little things that make each child feel noticed and special, outside birthdays and holidays.

name: Extended Family
description: Keeping the family connected to grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins, and in-laws on both sides.

name: Family Fun Nights
description: Regular time when the whole household does something enjoyable together at home: games, films, cooking, or a project.

name: Celebrating Milestones
description: Marking the moments that matter: first days, graduations, performances, promotions, and personal achievements for anyone in the family.

name: Showing Up at Events
description: Being present for children's games, concerts, assemblies, and ceremonies, so that someone they love is watching.

name: Faith, Culture & Values
description: Passing on what your family believes in and where it comes from: faith, heritage, language, food, and the principles you live by.

name: Big Questions
description: Children's questions about the hard and important things: bodies, where babies come from, death, money, difference, and what is in the news.

name: Costumes & Dress-up Days
description: Outfits for Halloween, school theme days, plays, recitals, and any day with a dress code announced at short notice.

name: Seasonal Fun
description: Making the most of each time of year: the beach, the pumpkin patch, sledding, fireworks, and local fairs.

name: Anniversaries
description: Marking your anniversary and the other dates that mean something to the two of you. You hold this one together.

name: Showing Up for Others
description: Being there for friends, neighbors, and relatives in their big moments, hard and happy: illness, loss, a new baby, a move.

name: Budget & Bills
description: The household's day-to-day money: knowing what comes in and goes out, paying every bill on time, and keeping both partners informed.

name: Taxes
description: Everything needed to file the household's taxes accurately and on time, and to keep the records that support them.

name: Insurance
description: All the household's cover: health, home or renters, car, life, disability, and anything else you hold. Includes renewals and claims.

name: Savings & Investing
description: The household's longer-term money: an emergency fund, retirement, education, and saving toward the things you want.

name: Wills & Key Documents
description: The legal and personal papers that protect your family: wills, guardianship, powers of attorney, life cover, beneficiaries, and identity documents.

name: Housing: Rent or Mortgage
description: The home as a financial and legal commitment: lease or mortgage, the landlord or lender, property taxes, and the decision to stay, renew, or look elsewhere.

name: Family Calendar
description: One shared, reliable picture of where everyone needs to be and when. This card is about keeping the calendar. The events themselves belong to other cards.

name: Car Care
description: Keeping the household's vehicles safe, legal, and running: servicing, tires, registration, inspections, and fuel. Cleaning is on the Car Cleaning card.

name: Errands & Returns
description: The small trips that keep life moving: returns, dry cleaning, the pharmacy, the post office, shoe repair, and similar stops.

name: Vet & Grooming
description: The health care of the family's animals: checkups, vaccines, preventive treatments, illness, grooming, and their records. Daily medications are on the Dog Daily Care card.

name: School Drop-off & Pickup
description: Getting children to and from school or daycare every day, on time, with what they need.

name: Activity Rides
description: Rides to and from everything outside school: practices, lessons, games, appointments, and parties.

name: School Forms & Enrollment
description: The administration of school life: choosing and applying to schools, registration, permission slips, health forms, fees, and moves between schools.

name: School Communication
description: Being the family's link with school or daycare: reading what they send, replying, and knowing how each child is doing.

name: School Events & Volunteering
description: The family's part in the school community: class events, fundraisers, trips, committees, and requests for help or contributions.

name: Activity Sign-ups
description: Choosing and arranging what children do outside school: sports, music, arts, clubs, and classes. Rides are on a separate card.

name: School Breaks & Summer
description: Covering every day school is closed while adults are working: holidays, teacher workdays, mid-year breaks, and the long summer break.

name: Childcare
description: Finding and managing the people and places that look after your children: daycare, a nanny, after-school care, and babysitters.

name: Travel Planning
description: Organizing trips away from home, from a weekend with relatives to a big vacation: transportation, somewhere to stay, and the paperwork.

name: Packing & Unpacking
description: Getting everyone's belongings ready for a trip or an outing, and dealing with all of it when you get home.

name: Weekend Plans
description: What the family does with its free time at weekends and on days off, so it is neither empty nor overloaded.

name: Couple Time & Social Plans
description: Time for the two of you as a couple, and your shared life with friends: date nights, dinners, parties, and get-togethers.

name: Community & Giving
description: The household's contribution beyond its own walls: charity, volunteering, voting, neighbors, and the groups you belong to.

name: Car Cleaning
description: Keeping the car clean inside and out: clearing it out, vacuuming, wiping down, and washing the outside. Servicing and repairs are on the Car Care card.

name: Baby Car Seat Cleaning
description: Keeping the baby's car seat clean and safe to use: the cover, padding, buckle, straps, and shell, plus the vehicle seat underneath it.

name: Moving House
description: Relocating the household, from deciding to go through to being settled in the new place.

name: New Baby
description: Preparing for and getting through the arrival of a child, by birth or adoption, and the first months that follow.

name: Job Change or Loss
description: A major shift in one partner's work: a new job, a layoff, reduced hours, or starting a business.

name: Serious Illness or Injury
description: A health crisis for someone in the household that changes what they can do for weeks, months, or longer.

name: Death in the Family
description: The loss of someone close, and both the practical and the emotional work that follows.

name: Home Renovation
description: A substantial building or remodeling project at home, from the first idea to the last snag.

name: Home Emergency
description: A sudden event that damages the home or makes it unlivable: flood, fire, storm, break-in, or a long loss of power or water.

name: New Pet
description: Bringing an animal into the family, from deciding whether to through its first months at home.

name: Big Career or Study Push
description: A demanding stretch for one partner, such as a degree, a qualification, a launch, or a busy season, that takes them away from home life.

name: Passion Project Time
description: Time for the pursuit that makes you feel most like yourself, beyond work and family: making, learning, playing, or building something. Each of you holds this card.
